parsed.rationale: This is a review of secure data analytics in smart grids published in Springer Proceedings in Energy (2025). Privacy is in the title, but the paper covers privacy-preserving mechanisms: homomorphic encryption, MPC, digital signatures, TLS, secure enclaves and federated learning. Inference risks get only motivating mentions, such as listing energy consumption patterns as sensitive data and a single sentence on membership inference attacks, with no paragraph explaining what can be inferred from consumption data, so the mechanism-only rule gives primary code A-E3.
